section.title: Exporting a card statement
section.scenario: Cardholders can download each monthly statement from the account page. The bank's compliance team set the export layout, a CSV with date, merchant and amount columns, and has said it is the only download format the bank will offer. About 300 statements are downloaded a month.
section.question: Which piece should produce the download, and which stated fact decides it?
section.piece_a:
class StatementExport
  HEADERS = %w[date merchant amount].freeze

  def initialize(statement)
    @statement = statement
  end

  def render
    CSV.generate do |csv|
      csv << HEADERS
      @statement.purchases.each do |purchase|
        csv << [purchase.posted_on, purchase.merchant, purchase.amount.to_s("F")]
      end
    end
  end
end
